title: 第二十五章 架打完护卫队就来了
novel_title: 凡人修仙：谁说修仙必须灵力
content_zh:
张麻子和手下扑向侯紫到时候，老崔都愣了，他也没想到，一个凡人敢挑衅修士。

    沈君壁已经从怀里掏出符纸就准备撕开发出符纸的时候。

    周边围着的人群突然鸦雀无声的时候。

    只听到侯紫说了句，“很好，就是这样干架。”

    这句话刚说完，他已经脚下吹起风，疾速一闪，就跟那天摘了陆续储物袋时一样飞快。然后一拳打碎了一个人的鼻子，一巴掌打聋了一个人的耳朵。反手一个肘击打断了张麻子的五根肋骨。

    踢出一脚将一个人踢得球一般滚出去，一脚反踢，另一人的裤裆挨了一下，已痛得弯下腰，眼泪、鼻涕、口水、冷汗、大小便，同时往外流。

    侯紫又疾行一步，一手掐住断了五根肋骨的张麻子的脖子，说“谁有道理？还要继续吗？”

    张麻子口不能说，摇头，拼命摇头。

    侯紫这才放了张麻子，说“很好，你们可以滚了。”

    老崔已经愣了，手无意识的托了一下铜框眼镜。

    沈君壁也想不到战斗这么快结束，也愣了。

    周围所有围观的散修全都愣了。

    这是凡人吗！

    巷子里安静了几息。张麻子捂着肋骨从地上爬起来，两个手下一个捂着鼻子一个捂着裤裆，三人连滚带爬地往巷子深处跑。跑了没几步，巷口传来一阵整齐的脚步声。

    张麻子的脚步停了。那脚步声他太熟了，贫民窟里没人走路这么齐。
content_en:
When Zhang Mazi and his men pounced on Hou Zi, Lao Cui was stunned. He did not expect that a mortal would dare to provoke the monk.

Shen Junbi had already taken out the talisman paper from his arms and was about to tear it apart.

When the crowd surrounding him suddenly fell silent.

I only heard Hou Zi say, "Very good, let's fight like this."

As soon as he finished saying this, the wind started blowing under his feet, and he flashed as fast as when he picked up the storage bags one after another that day.Then he broke a man's nose with a punch, and deafened a man's ears with a slap.A backhand elbow broke five of Zhang Mazi's ribs.

He kicked one person out like a ball and kicked him back, hitting the other person's crotch. He bent over in pain, and tears, snot, saliva, cold sweat, and urine and urine all flowed out at the same time.

Hou Zi took another quick step, pinched the neck of Zhang Mazi, who had five broken ribs, and said, "Who is right? Do you want to continue?"

Zhang Mazi couldn't speak, he shook his head, shaking his head desperately.

Hou Zi then let Zhang Mazi go and said, "Very good, you can get out."

Lao Cui was stunned, and unconsciously raised his copper-rimmed glasses with his hand.

Shen Junbi also didn't expect the battle to end so quickly and was stunned.

All the casual cultivators watching around were stunned.

Is this a mortal!

The alley was quiet for a few moments.Zhang Mazi got up from the ground while holding his ribs. One of his two men covered his nose and the other his crotch. The three of them rolled and crawled deeper into the alley.After running a few steps, the sound of neat footsteps came from the alley.

Zhang Mazi's footsteps stopped.He was so familiar with the sound of footsteps. No one in the slums walked in such unison.
title_en: Chapter 25 The escort came after the fight
